courses.title: 光子晶片晶圓級光測試
courses.titleEn: Wafer-level optical testing of photonic chips
courses.summary: 從晶圓位置、耦合去嵌入與量測統計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate wafer position, coupling de-embedding and measurement statistics, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設同型耦合器的 1 cm 與 3 cm 波導總損耗分別為 5.2 與 6.0 dB：α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm；共同截距=4.8 dB。若兩次獨立量測的標準不確定度各 0.10 dB，u(α)=√2×0.10/2=0.071 dB/cm，未含長度或耦合器變異。
workedExample.textEn: Assume matched-coupler waveguides of 1 and 3 cm have 5.2 and 6.0 dB total loss. α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm and intercept=4.8 dB. Two independent 0.10 dB standard uncertainties give u(α)=0.071 dB/cm, excluding length and coupler variation.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume matched wavelength, polarization and couplers with linear length dependence; real processes need multiple lengths and repeats.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 座標與去嵌入
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「座標與去嵌入」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine coordinates and de-embedding, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 晶圓座標：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「晶圓座標」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for wafer coordinates, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「晶圓座標」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for wafer coordinates, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。
steps.observationEn: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Untested dies automatically count as passes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶圓座標的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for wafer coordinates, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: IL(L)=αL+C；不確定度要按協方差傳播，共同校正誤差不一定獨立。 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。

quiz.question: 要審查「晶圓座標」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing wafer coordinates?
options: 缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。
未測晶粒應自動算通過。
單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。
optionsEn: Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die.
Untested dies automatically count as passes.
One exterior photograph measures propagation loss.

quiz.explanationEn: Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.

steps.title: 晶圓座標：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「晶圓座標」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for wafer coordinates, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。」與錯誤假說「單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die." against the incorrect hypothesis "One exterior photograph measures propagation loss."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One exterior photograph measures propagation loss. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶圓座標的量測判別表：以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for wafer coordinates: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析
courses.summary: 從熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩材料 CTE 差 Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K、長度 L=10 mm、溫差 ΔT=50 K，自由失配位移 Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm。這不是實際封裝位移或應力；機械拘束、翹曲與材料溫度依賴尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K, L=10 mm and ΔT=50 K. Free mismatch Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm. This is not actual package displacement or stress; constraints, curvature and temperature-dependent properties are omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 小變形、局部線性近似；不同晶向、塑性與黏彈歷史需另建模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-deformation/local-linear approximation; crystal orientation, plasticity and viscoelastic history need separate models.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光路溫度漂移補償
courses.summary: 從漂移量測、熱串擾與穩定回授拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate drift sensing, thermal crosstalk and stable feedback, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設共振溫度斜率 80 pm/K，環境變化 3 K 產生 240 pm 漂移；假設加熱器斜率 40 pm/mW，要反向補償 240 pm 需相對原偏壓減少 6 mW。若原偏壓僅 4 mW，單純加熱器無法完成此負向補償。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 80 pm/K resonance drift and a 3 K change: 240 pm. With 40 pm/mW heater slope, opposing this shift requires reducing bias by 6 mW. A 4 mW initial bias cannot supply that negative correction.
workedExample.assumptions: 局部線性且固定偏振；這組斜率是假想值，沒有代表特定製程。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local linearity and fixed polarization; slopes are hypothetical, not a process specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光子封裝失效重路由
courses.summary: 從N−1 連通、光功率裕度與恢復狀態機拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate N−1 connectivity, optical power margins and restoration state machines, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想網路兩條路徑 S-A-T 的損耗為 1+1=2 dB；S-B-C-T 為 1.5+1.5+1.5=4.5 dB。若發射 0 dBm、接收門檻 −6 dBm，正常裕度 4 dB、備援裕度 1.5 dB；要求保留 2 dB 時備援雖連通仍不合格。移除共用 S 或 T 則兩路均失效，不能宣稱全節點 N−1。另作容量檢驗：假設兩條互不共用瓶頸的路徑各100 Gb/s，正常共200 Gb/s；失去一條後剩100 Gb/s，若最低服務需150 Gb/s，仍有連通也不合格。
workedExample.textEn: Hypothetical routes S-A-T lose 2 dB and S-B-C-T lose 4.5 dB. With 0 dBm launch and −6 dBm receiver threshold, margins are 4 and 1.5 dB. A 2 dB reserve rejects the connected backup. Removing shared S or T disables both, so full node-N−1 is not achieved. For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想無增益線性路由；門檻與損失為教學假設，未包含非線性、相干串音與 FEC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear routes without gain; assumed thresholds/losses exclude nonlinear effects, coherent crosstalk and FEC.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.

courses.title: 封裝應力對光學相位的影響
courses.summary: 從晶向、應變張量、模態重疊與光程拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal axes, strain tensors, modal overlap and optical path, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 λ=1.55 µm、L=1 mm、neff=2.4、Δneff=1×10⁻⁵、軸向應變 ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵，則 ΔL=10 nm；材料項 Δφn=0.0405 rad，長度項 ΔφL=0.0973 rad，总計 0.1378 rad。Δneff 是假設的有效模態變化，不是引用矽的固定塊材係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume λ=1.55 µm, L=1 mm, neff=2.4, Δneff=10⁻⁵ and axial strain ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵, giving ΔL=10 nm. The index term is 0.0405 rad and length term 0.0973 rad, totaling 0.1378 rad. Δneff is an assumed modal change, not a fixed bulk-silicon coefficient.
workedExample.assumptions: 小擾動且真空波長固定；張量、偏振、材料色散和幾何重算需在完整模型中處理。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small perturbations at fixed vacuum wavelength; full models treat tensors, polarization, dispersion and deformed geometry.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate PDK versions, design rules, model corners and assembly handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設路徑有兩耦合器各 1.5 dB、四分光器各 0.2 dB 超額損失及 2 cm 波導 α=0.5 dB/cm，總額外損失=3+0.8+1=4.8 dB。若波導角落 α=0.8，其他固定，為 5.4 dB；6 dB 額外損耗預算的裕度由 1.2 變成 0.6 dB。理想分光到特定支路的功率分配損失須另加，不能漏算。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two 1.5 dB couplers, four 0.2 dB splitter excess losses and 2 cm at 0.5 dB/cm: extra loss is 4.8 dB. At 0.8 dB/cm it becomes 5.4 dB, reducing a 6 dB excess-loss budget margin from 1.2 to 0.6 dB. Ideal splitting to the selected branch must be added separately.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想元件庫和損失，非任一 PDK 規格；不分發受限制 PDK。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical library/losses, not a PDK specification; restricted PDKs are not redistributed.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
courses.summary: 從交換 ASIC、光引擎、雷射與散熱的共同介面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint switch-ASIC, optical-engine, laser and cooling interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想系統有 ASIC 600 W、8 個光引擎每個 15 W、外接雷射 40 W、控制 10 W，系統合計 770 W。若8個引擎每個單向 1.6 Tb/s，單向總量 12.8 Tb/s；770/12.8×10¹²=60.2 pJ/bit 是此系統邊界的平均能量，不能稱為光子晶片本身能效。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical system has a 600 W ASIC, eight 15 W engines, 40 W external lasers and 10 W control: 770 W. Eight 1.6 Tb/s one-way engines total 12.8 Tb/s. 770/(12.8×10¹²)=60.2 pJ/bit is system-boundary energy, not intrinsic photonic-chip efficiency.
workedExample.assumptions: 固定滿載、未加備援與冷卻設施功耗；教學數字不代表任何商用 CPO。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fixed full load excludes spare capacity and facility cooling; values do not describe a commercial CPO product.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

options: 光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。
雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。
光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。
optionsEn: Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots.
Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity.
Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design.
quiz.explanation: 光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。 按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。
quiz.explanationEn: Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots. Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift.

steps.title: 熱預算：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「熱預算」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for thermal budget, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。」與錯誤假說「光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots." against the incorrect hypothesis "Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。

quiz.question: 要審查「系統驗收」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？

courses.title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片
courses.summary: 從通道、光波長、能量及端到端可用容量拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設每方向 64 通道、每通道 32 Gb/s，則單向=2.048 Tb/s，雙向合計=4.096 Tb/s。若有效負載比例 0.90，單向有效=1.8432 Tb/s。另假設完整光 I/O 功耗 10 W，按單向有效容量計為 5.43 pJ/bit；若改用雙向分母，必須也定義同時雙向負載。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 64 lanes per direction at 32 Gb/s: 2.048 Tb/s one way and 4.096 Tb/s aggregate. At 90% payload, one-way useful capacity is 1.8432 Tb/s. A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.
workedExample.assumptions: 通道參數是教學設計，並非複製某晶片所有規格；BER 近似假設獨立稀少錯誤。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Lane inputs are educational, not a complete device specification; BER approximation assumes rare independent errors.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

List capacities per direction; their sum is a particular aggregate convention. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

steps.check: 提交單向與雙向的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。」反駁模型的預測。

courses.title: 光子與電子晶片共同設計
courses.summary: 從驅動器、調變器、光偵測器和 TIA 的共同負載拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint driver, modulator, photodetector and TIA loading, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 lumped 驅動器 R=50 Ω、PIC及封裝總電容 C=100 fF，fRC=1/(2πRC)=31.8 GHz。若接點再加 50 fF，變成 21.2 GHz。這只是一階電 RC，不代表完整電光 3 dB 頻寬；電極分布、光子壽命和接收器尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a lumped 50 Ω driver and 100 fF total load: fRC=31.8 GHz. Another 50 fF lowers it to 21.2 GHz. This is only a first-order electrical RC limit, not complete electro-optic bandwidth; electrode distribution, photon lifetime and receiver are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 小訊號線性模型、固定偏壓與端接；需用非線性時域資料驗證大訊號。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-signal linear model at fixed bias/termination; large signals need nonlinear time-domain validation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 參考面與頻寬
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「參考面與頻寬」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine reference planes and bandwidth, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 介面參考面：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Interface reference planes: model and design
steps.objective: 以「介面參考面」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for interface reference planes, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「介面參考面」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for interface reference planes, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。
steps.observationEn: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for interface reference planes, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.

quiz.question: 要審查「介面參考面」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing interface reference planes?
options: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。
總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。
光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。
optionsEn: Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated.
Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component.
An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths.
quiz.explanation: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。

steps.title: 介面參考面：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Interface reference planes: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「介面參考面」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated." against the incorrect hypothesis "An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的量測判別表：定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for interface reference planes: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: 高速光模組電磁相容性
courses.titleEn: Electromagnetic compatibility of high-speed optical modules
courses.summary: 從發射源、耦合路徑、接收端與可重現測試拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate emission sources, coupling paths, victims and reproducible tests, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 教學接收電壓 100 µV 對 1 µV 基準為 20log10(100)=40 dBµV；降到 20 µV 為 26.02 dBµV，降低 13.98 dB。若纜線損失 2 dB 且需回推源端，應加 2 dB。這些數字不是任何標準的合格限值。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching receiver voltage of 100 µV is 40 dBµV; 20 µV is 26.02 dBµV, a 13.98 dB reduction. Add a 2 dB cable loss when referring back to the source. These are not acceptance limits from a standard.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設同一量測阻抗、檢波器與帶寬；正式測試依適用標準和校正配置。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume matched impedance, detector and bandwidth; formal testing follows applicable standards and calibrated setup.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光收發器雷射安全與互鎖
courses.summary: 從設備分類、可接近發射與故障安全狀態拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate equipment classification, accessible emission and fail-safe states, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 非發光邏輯教學假設：偵測延遲 0.5 ms、控制延遲 1.0 ms、致動回應 2.0 ms，名義總延遲=3.5 ms。若各自獨立最大界限另加 0.2、0.3、0.5 ms，保守相加為 4.5 ms。這只是排程上界，不是安全暴露時間，也不推定任何雷射等級合格。
workedExample.textEn: Non-emitting logic example: detection 0.5 ms, control 1.0 ms and actuation 2.0 ms total 3.5 ms. Adding separate worst-case allowances of 0.2, 0.3 and 0.5 ms gives 4.5 ms. This scheduling bound is not a safe exposure time and establishes no laser-class compliance.
workedExample.assumptions: 只模擬非發光狀態與邏輯；實際雷射操作、分類和測試由合格人員與設備完成。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Simulate only non-emitting states/logic; real operation, classification and testing require qualified personnel and equipment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 台積電 CoWoS 整合案例
courses.summary: 從CoWoS 變體、中介層、HBM 與封裝整合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate CoWoS variants, interposers, HBM and package integration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設有效直線互連邊長 10 mm、單列節距 50 µm，理想位置數 floor(10000/50)=200。若教學預留40個供電/接地、20個備用，最多140個訊號位置。此一維上限未包含多列、禁佈區和布線可達性，不是 CoWoS 公開或保密的實際節距。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 mm effective shoreline and 50 µm single-row pitch: floor(10000/50)=200 positions. Reserving 40 for power/ground and 20 spare leaves at most 140 signals. This 1D bound excludes multiple rows, keepouts and routability and is not a CoWoS process pitch.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想一維幾何，只用來練習介面預算；實際設計須取得供應商平台規則。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical 1D geometry for interface budgeting; real design requires supplier platform rules.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 台積電 SoIC 堆疊整合案例
courses.summary: 從SoIC 垂直分割、接合界面與後段整合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate SoIC vertical partitioning, bonding interfaces and downstream integration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設四顆晶粒在既定篩選後各有 0.99 的可用機率，三個接合界面各有 0.995 的成功機率，且所有事件獨立，則 Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463，約94.63%。這是未提供重工的教學模型；若有共同污染、測試漏失相關或挑選配對，應改用條件機率，不能當成 SoIC 量產良率。
workedExample.textEn: Assume four screened dies each have 0.99 usable probability and three interfaces each have 0.995 success, all independent: Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463 or 94.63%. This no-rework teaching model is not SoIC production yield; common contamination, correlated escapes or selection require conditional probabilities.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想獨立事件、固定測試覆蓋及無重工；不包含供應商未公開參數。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical independent events, fixed test coverage and no rework; no undisclosed vendor parameters.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: Intel Foveros 封裝案例
courses.summary: 從Foveros 平台變體與立體功能分割拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate Foveros variants and three-dimensional functional partitioning, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
workedExample.textEn: For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear capacitor/resistive charging excludes leakage, short-circuit, drivers, clocks and protocol overhead; values are not Foveros specifications.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「接合路線」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。微凸塊和直接銅接合的幾何、材料及熱機械界面不同，不能共用所有設計規則。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較公開結構的寄生與缺陷類型，不捏造製程節距或配方。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for bonding choices, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Microbumps and direct copper bonding differ in geometry, materials and thermomechanical interfaces. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare public structures' parasitics/defects without inventing pitch or recipes. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.

steps.title: 接合路線：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「接合路線」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Microbumps and direct copper bonding differ in geometry, materials and thermomechanical interfaces." against the incorrect hypothesis "Every Foveros variant has identical bonding material and architecture."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.

steps.observationEn: Compare public structures' parasitics/defects without inventing pitch or recipes.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Estored=½CV²；Esupply,charge=CV²；Pdynamic=αCV²f，α須明確定義。 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。

quiz.question: 要審查「訊號與返回」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing signals and returns?
options: 電容儲能就是完整系統每位元能量。
垂直堆疊縮小面積就必然降低所有熱點溫度。
高密度接點仍需足夠返回電流通路，不是所有接點都能計為資料位元。
optionsEn: Capacitor stored energy equals full-system energy per bit.
Smaller stacked footprint necessarily lowers every hotspot.
Dense contacts still need returns; not every contact is a data bit.
quiz.explanation: 高密度接點仍需足夠返回電流通路，不是所有接點都能計為資料位元。 從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。

steps.title: 訊號與返回：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Signals and returns: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「訊號與返回」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Deduct power, ground, clocks and test from contact count to recalculate signals. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Dense contacts still need returns; not every contact is a data bit." against the incorrect hypothesis "Smaller stacked footprint necessarily lowers every hotspot."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。

steps.check: 提交訊號與返回的量測判別表：從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for signals and returns: Deduct power, ground, clocks and test from contact count to recalculate signals. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: Intel EMIB 互連橋案例
courses.summary: 從EMIB 嵌入式橋接、返回路徑與組合封裝拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate EMIB embedded bridges, return paths and package composition, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想均勻傳輸線長 L=5 mm、有效相對介電常數 εeff=4，v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s，因此單向傳播延遲約33.3 ps。若資料單位間隔 UI=100 ps，此延遲為0.333 UI，但固定延遲不是同量的抖動或眼圖閉合。這不是 EMIB 產品長度或材料規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical 5 mm uniform line with εeff=4, v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s, giving about 33.3 ps one-way delay. At a 100 ps UI this is 0.333 UI; fixed delay is not equivalent jitter or eye closure. These are not EMIB product dimensions/materials.
workedExample.assumptions: 準 TEM、均勻有效介質與固定頻段的教學近似，未包含接點不連續及導體損耗。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Teaching quasi-TEM uniform-effective-medium approximation over a fixed band; contact discontinuities and conductor loss are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台
courses.summary: 從iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一模態、局部近似與假想群折射率；未包含耦合器相位色散、溫度漂移及實際製程分布。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single mode, local approximation and hypothetical group index; coupler phase dispersion, thermal drift and process distributions are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

history.title: 可重組光子網格的研究案例

history.title: 矽光彈量測重視方向與溫度
history.titleEn: Silicon photoelastic measurements depend on orientation and temperature
history.text: Dickmann 等人的原始研究量測 1550 nm 下矽的光彈係數及其溫度、晶向依賴。本課把材料證據與模態重疊、幾何光程分開。
history.textEn: Dickmann and colleagues measured silicon photoelastic response at 1550 nm with temperature and orientation dependence. This course separates material evidence from mode overlap and geometric path length.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 熱擾動與應力擾動必須分離
history.titleEn: Separating thermal and stress perturbations
history.text: 公開熱調波導模型說明溫度也會改變光學結果。本課據此安排固定溫度的應力對照，避免將所有相位漂移都歸因於光彈效應。
history.textEn: The public thermally tuned waveguide model shows temperature also changes optical response. The course therefore adds constant-temperature stress comparisons instead of assigning all phase drift to photoelasticity.

history.text: Intel 發表與處理器共同展示的光學 I/O 小晶片，成為比較容量、方向及功耗邊界的案例。本課算例是自行設定，不是完整產品規格。
history.textEn: Intel presented an optical-I/O chiplet alongside a processor, providing a case for comparing capacity, direction and power boundaries. Course calculations are independently chosen, not full product specifications.

history.titleEn: Capacity demonstrations need test methods

history.textEn: AIM TAP testing context motivates retaining BER, temperature and calibration conditions with bandwidth demonstrations. This is an educational acceptance framework, not additional undisclosed specifications.

history.title: 光子與 TIA 共同設計案例
history.titleEn: A photonics and TIA co-design case
history.text: Ghent 的 40 GBd 相干接收器研究將矽光子電路與 SiGe TIA 一起設計。本課以此說明電、光模型必須共享參考面和負載條件。
history.textEn: The Ghent 40-GBd coherent-receiver study co-designed silicon photonics with a SiGe TIA, illustrating why electrical and optical models need shared planes and load conditions.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 從接收器到完整光學 I/O
history.titleEn: From receivers to complete optical I/O
history.text: Intel 光學 I/O 展示提供系統整合案例。本課由此延伸，把驅動、接收、光源與控制分別列入負載及功耗，而不把局部 RC 頻寬當整條鏈路性能。
history.textEn: Intel optical-I/O demonstration provides system context. The course separately accounts for drivers, receivers, sources and control rather than treating a local RC limit as full-link performance.

history.title: 設備發射規範需核對版本
history.titleEn: Equipment-emission rules need revision control
history.text: CISPR 32 的合併版本納入 2019 修訂；它是設備發射範圍的來源入口，不是所有光模組自動適用的全部符合性規範。
history.textEn: The consolidated CISPR 32 includes the 2019 amendment. It provides equipment-emission scope, not an automatic complete compliance framework for every optical module.

history.titleEn: Module interfaces complement standards
history.text: OIF 的共封裝介面說明提供電、光與機械分工背景。本課據此將接地、外殼、管理纜線與光學性能共同列入修改後回歸，適用 EMC 規範仍需另行確認。
history.textEn: OIF provides interface partitioning. The course includes grounds, enclosures, management cables and optical behavior in regression after changes; EMC applicability remains separately determined.

history.title: 完整產品的雷射分類
history.titleEn: Laser classification of complete products
history.text: IEC 60825-1 第三版提供雷射產品安全分類的規範脈絡。本課只練習非發光互鎖邏輯與證據交接，分類和實際測試須依適用標準完成。
history.textEn: IEC 60825-1 edition 3 provides laser-product classification context. This course practices non-emitting interlock logic and evidence handoff; actual classification/testing follow applicable standards.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 介面協議不代替安全分類
history.titleEn: Interface agreements do not classify laser safety
history.text: ELSFP 提供光源模組的介面脈絡。本課明確區分功能管理與安全驗證：介面互通不能代替完整產品可接近發射的合格評估。
history.textEn: ELSFP supplies source-module interface context. The course separates functional management from safety validation: interoperability does not replace qualified accessible-emission assessment of a complete product.

history.title: CoWoS 從平台走向多種中介策略
history.titleEn: CoWoS evolves into multiple interposer strategies
history.text: TSMC 公開說明 CoWoS 自 2012 年量產，後續以 S、R、L 區分整合路線。比較時先核對變體，才討論互連、熱與可測試性。
history.textEn: TSMC states CoWoS entered production in 2012 and describes S/R/L routes. Comparisons first identify the variant before evaluating interconnect, heat and testability.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 前段堆疊銜接後段整合
history.titleEn: Stacking hands off to package integration

history.textEn: TSMC describes SoIC-to-CoWoS compatibility. The course turns this into a cross-platform test, thermal-model and die-identity handoff, still requiring each platform’s formal rules.

history.title: SoIC 公開堆疊平台演進
history.titleEn: Public SoIC stacking-platform evolution
history.text: TSMC 記錄 3 nm 晶粒堆疊於 2025 年進入量產，並說明 SoIC 可再銜接其他封裝。本課關注這些交接邊界，不推定內部配方或良率。
history.textEn: TSMC records 3-nm stacking production in 2025 and describes downstream packaging compatibility. The course studies these handoffs without inferring recipes or yield.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 垂直整合還需要外部系統
history.titleEn: Vertical integration still needs the external system
history.text: CoWoS 公開平台提供多晶粒封裝背景。本課的延伸是堆疊完成後再檢查基板供電、翹曲、記憶體介面及散熱，不能只在垂直接點通過時停止驗證。
history.textEn: CoWoS provides multi-die package context. The course therefore checks substrate power, warpage, memory interfaces and cooling after stacking rather than stopping at vertical-contact continuity.
